conditions.text: Set up the app at version 3.2.0 on iOS 18.4, device model iPhone15,2 — these values were identical in all events considered.
The profile state must be inconsistent going in: profile.consistent is false in every event.

Push was fully functional in every event (deliverable true, OS permission ALLOWED, provider registration REGISTERED); the packet does not say whether push state is required for the failure or just incidental.
No condition in the packet is listed as varying between events, but with only 2 events considered the packet gives no basis for deciding which of these preconditions are actually necessary.

Commit c32b555, "Sync profile postal code on save", touches the same file as the culprit frame (src/modules/profile/profile.store.ts) and is a lead worth checking when reproducing, not a confirmed cause.

missing_evidence_questions.text: What makes profile.consistent false — which field or flow puts the local job profile postal code out of step with the backend, so the state can be set up deliberately?
What does the 409 response body from PUT /api/profile contain, and does the backend need a specific stored postal code for the mismatch to trigger?
Does the failure reproduce on other app versions, OS versions or devices, or is it specific to 3.2.0 on iOS 18.4 / iPhone15,2?
Is the push state (deliverable, ALLOWED, REGISTERED) relevant at all, or can the repro be done with push disabled?
Did occurrences start after commit c32b555 landed, and what did savePostalCode do at line 140 before that change?
Are there more than the 2 events behind this packet that could confirm which steps and preconditions are consistently present?

steps_prose.text: Navigate to /profile in the app; this appears in both considered events (support 1.0).
Tap the save control button#save-profile on that screen.
The app issues PUT /api/profile, which comes back 409.
At that point savePostalCode in src/modules/profile/profile.store.ts (line 140) throws Error: "Postal code mismatch between backend and job profile".

summary.text: The incident is an Error, "Postal code mismatch between backend and job profile", raised in savePostalCode at src/modules/profile/profile.store.ts:140 when the profile is saved and the backend responds 409 to PUT /api/profile; the packet is derived from 2 events.
